input.overview: Spot the flashing city lights to qualify a lock at the Truck Stop gas station. Shoot the gas station to lock a ball, then shoot it again before the Release lamp goes out to start two-ball Multiball. Build the five-city grid with ramp and lit-mushroom shots; once full, spell C-I-T-Y on the ramp before the Jackpot timer expires.
input.simpleOverview: Spot flashing city lights until Lock is lit, then shoot the Truck Stop gas station to hold a ball. Shoot the gas station again before Release goes out for two-ball Multiball. Keep making city shots to fill the grid; when it is full, make the four C-I-T-Y ramp shots before the Jackpot value times out.
input.summary: Spot flashing city lights, lock at the Truck Stop gas station, then shoot the gas station again before Release goes out for two-ball Multiball. Fill the city grid, then spell C-I-T-Y on the ramp before the Jackpot timer expires.

steps.text: Spot the flashing city lights until Lock is lit at the Truck Stop gas station.
Shoot the gas station to lock a ball.
Shoot the gas station again before the Release lamp goes out to release the lock and start two-ball Multiball.
Build the city grid with ramp and lit-mushroom shots; after the grid is full, complete the four C-I-T-Y ramp letters before the Jackpot timer expires.

alternatives.title: Spot a whole city
alternatives.when: Use this when the six blue targets are safer than individual city shots.

steps.text: Complete the six blue targets to light Spot City at the ramp.
Shoot the lit ramp to fill the current city grid at once.
Use ramp and lit-mushroom shots to collect city letters between lock attempts.
Complete the inline drops to begin the bonus timer, then hit the center green target before it expires to raise Bonus X.
Hit both orange targets within their timer to light Extra Ball at the dock saucer.

machineSetup: Confirm Release-lamp time, Jackpot timer, extra-ball, and bonus settings before competitive play.
Test the gas-station lock and release, city lamps, ramp, mushrooms, six blue targets, inline drops, center green target, orange targets, and dock saucer.

cautions.issue: The second gas-station shot must arrive before the Release lamp goes out.
cautions.response: After locking, prioritize the return to the gas station instead of assuming the lock will wait indefinitely.
